recap: Day 1 (June 25, 2026) introduced Safeeely - an AI-escrow bot for DM deals (social media sales, freelance gigs, crypto) used via Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp/Instagram/Apple bots under a 'safetag' handle. Days 1-18 covered early money bugs, a WhatsApp notification chase, a huge solo admin-dashboard build, a 44-field settings rebuild, badge cards across all six bots, a five-leak memory hunt, free in-house support ticketing built by reusing the dispute system's pipes, an AI feedback-digest tool, a raw STEP_UP_REQUIRED error code shown to users, and a third instance of the same missing-await bug spiking server memory during dispute auto-enforcement. Day 19 (July 6, 2026) fixed the STEP_UP_REQUIRED saga for real: replaced the bot-redirect confirmation flow with an emailed 6-digit OTP that self-elevates the session and auto-completes the withdrawal in place, since email was the one channel reliable across every platform. Day 20 (also July 6, 2026, later that morning) rebuilt the public guides/delivery page pixel-perfect to match a new design, then caught and fixed a UX bug on it forty minutes later: the nav and footer CTAs both said 'Dashboard,' a dead end for the logged-out strangers the page was actually written for. This closes out the backfill - the story is now caught up to the repo's live history, and future days will cover new commits as they land.
